title: Divisional Risk and Control Specialist, VP
description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Job Title: Divisional Risk and Control Specialist, VP**

**Location: Pune, India**

**Corporate Title: VP**

**Role Description**

Corporate Banking is a technology-driven business operating in an increasingly real-time, interconnected environment, where clients expect seamless services, integrated platforms and trusted access to data. Corporate Bank (CB) Technology supports this ambition through a complex global ecosystem of business-critical applications, platforms, data services and infrastructure. We are seeking an experienced technology risk professional to play a key role in our Proactive Risk Testing Programme, delivering rigorous, risk-based assessments across this landscape. The role requires the ability to develop a deep understanding of applications and their end-to-end architecture, critically evaluate the design and effectiveness of implemented technology controls, and identify both existing and emerging IT and Information Security risks. Working closely with senior technology, business and control stakeholders, you will translate complex technical observations into clear risk insights, strengthen the testing strategy and drive sustainable improvements that enhance the resilience, security and control environment of mission-critical technology services.

**What we’ll offer you**

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy

* Best in class leave policy
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above  

**Your key responsibilities**

Reporting locally to the India Corporate Bank Technology Control Testing Lead in Pune and functionally to the CB Technology Testing Lead based in London, you will:

* Lead and deliver risk-based, end-to-end IT and Information Security assessments across the Corporate Bank (CB) Technology landscape, independently assessing the design, implementation and operating effectiveness of key controls.
* Develop an in-depth understanding of business services and their supporting technology, including application and platform architecture, infrastructure, databases, operating systems, cloud services, networks, interfaces, APIs, data flows, batch and real-time processing, and third-party dependencies.
* Perform technical deep dives across applications, platforms, databases and infrastructure to identify and assess existing and emerging IT and IS risks, control weaknesses, root causes, systemic themes and potential impacts on confidentiality, integrity, resilience and regulatory compliance.
* Assess technology lifecycle risks and controls including design, development and production considering aspects such as access management, security, operations and resilience.
* Apply professional judgement to define risk-based testing scope, develop risk and control matrices, determine sampling and testing approaches, analyze technical evidence, and produce clear, well-supported conclusions in line with testing standards.
* Challenge technology and control owners constructively, communicate complex technical risks in business terms and support agreement on pragmatic and sustainable remediation actions.
* Identify cross-application and thematic risks, emerging technology threats, control automation opportunities and opportunities to use data analytics and continuous monitoring to improve assurance coverage.
* Partner with Technology Application Teams, Architects, Engineering, Information Security, Control Owners, the Divisional Control Office, Group Audit and other stakeholders to promote transparency and sustainable risk mitigation.
Contribute to the ongoing enhancement of risk-based testing methodologies, standards, documentation and quality assurance, while providing guidance and technical coaching to colleagues where required.  

**Your skills and experience**

* Extensive experience in IT/Cyber security assessments, technology risk, information security, controls assurance or related discipline, including leading complex reviews in a large, regulated organization.
* In-depth understanding of enterprise technology and application architecture, including cloud and on-premises infrastructure, databases, operating systems, networks, APIs, middleware, data integration and third-party services.
* Demonstrable ability to analyze architecture diagrams, data flows, configurations, system logs, access models, vulnerability information and other technical evidence to identify control gaps and assess their business and risk impact.
* Strong knowledge of IT General Controls and Application Controls, cyber security, secure software development, identity and access management, privileged access management, network and cloud security, vulnerability management, data and cryptographic protection, security monitoring, incident management, operational resilience and technology lifecycle management.
* Awareness of emerging technology and risk areas, including cloud security, DevSecOps, automation, artificial intelligence, open-source software, third-party concentration and evolving cyber threats.
* Experience applying recognized frameworks and standards such as COBIT, NIST, ISO 27001, ITIL and relevant regulatory expectations; professional certifications such as CISA, CISSP, CRISC, or equivalent is desirable.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, with the confidence to challenge senior stakeholders and translate complex technical matters into concise, risk-based findings and practical remediation actions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and deliver high-quality outcomes.
Experience working in Agile and DevOps environments; knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and its control environment would be an advantage.  

  

**Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.**

**How we’ll support you**

* Training and development to help you excel in your career

* Coaching and support from experts in your team

* A culture of continuous learning to aid progression

A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs  



**About us and our teams**

Please visit our company website for further information:

**https://www.db.com/company/company.html**

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

* Proficiency in **multi-core, low-latency C/C++** programming — concurrency, memory optimization, and zero-copy techniques.
* Strong **debugging and profiling** skills across complex, multi-threaded networking environments.

**Nice to Have**

* Familiarity with NGFW security services from leading industry vendors.
* Exposure to modern encrypted protocol standards (HTTP/3, QUIC, DoH, ECH/ESNI).
* Experience with virtual or cloud firewall performance tuning.
* Hands-on with network traffic generation and testing tools (Spirent, IXIA, TRex).

***Job Title:*** *Azure Cloud Platform Engineer* ***Company****: Toro Technology Center India*

  
  

**Who Are We?**

The Toro Company is a homegrown, Minnesota-based company that has been in business since 1914. We pride ourselves on providing world-class equipment to help maintain the environment that we love, while putting an emphasis on giving back to the communities that surround us. From residential lawns and gardens to Golf Clubs and sports grounds we are a company with a global footprint and a passion for helping people beautify whatever landscape they may be in. With 100+ years of operation under our belt and an average employee tenure of 15 years, come find out what makes The Toro Company the best place to build a career.

**What Will You Do?**

In order to grow and build a successful career with The Toro Company, you will be responsible for:

* Collaborate with technical leadership, architecture, security, application, data, and AI teams to design and deliver secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective Azure platform solutions.
* Engineer and support enterprise Azure Landing Zones, management groups, subscriptions, resource organization, tagging, policy, logging, and governance patterns.
* Design and implement Azure networking and connectivity patterns, including VNets, DNS, firewalls, private endpoints, routing, and secure hybrid or enterprise connectivity.
* Build and maintain reusable Infrastructure as Code using Terraform as a core engineering tool; use Bicep and Azure Verified Modules where they provide a strong Azure-native fit.
* Develop versioned, tested, reusable IaC modules and platform patterns that standardize cloud provisioning and reduce manual deployment effort.
* Build and maintain CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions and/or Azure DevOps, including reusable workflows, environment promotion, approvals, testing, and deployment traceability.
* Implement secure cloud identity patterns using Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, managed identities, Privileged Identity Management, Key Vault, and workload identity or OIDC-based authentication.
* Embed security and governance into engineering workflows using least privilege, Azure Policy, secure defaults, vulnerability and secret scanning, and documented exception handling.
* Build observability and operational readiness using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, dashboards, actionable alerting, runbooks, and service ownership practices.
* Own platform capabilities across their lifecycle - design, build, deployment, operations, incident response, root-cause analysis, resilience improvement, and retirement.
* Apply cloud FinOps practices including cost allocation, tagging, budgeting, forecasting, rightsizing, utilization analysis, anomaly identification, and optimization recommendations.
* Automate recurring operational and provisioning activities using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or equivalent scripting and automation techniques.
* Partner with application, data, analytics, and AI engineering teams to provide secure cloud foundations, connectivity, compute, storage, and deployment patterns for modern workloads.
* Create clear technical documentation, reference architectures, reusable examples, and knowledge-transfer material that supports consistent adoption across global teams.

**What Do You Need?**

To be considered for this role, an individual should meet the following minimal requirements:

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* 5+ years of experience in Cloud, Infrastructure, DevOps, or Platform Engineering, including at least 3 years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure.
* Strong hands-on experience with Terraform, including reusable modules, remote state, versioning, environment separation, and production deployment patterns.
* Strong experience with Azure platform services, networking, identity, security, governance, and automation.
* Experience with Azure DevOps and/or GitHub Enterprise, including CI/CD pipelines or GitHub Actions and source-control-based engineering practices.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, managed identities, Azure Policy, Key Vault, private endpoints, and enterprise networking concepts.
* Experience with observability, monitoring, incident response, operational support, and reliability practices for production cloud services.
* Proficiency in at least one scripting or automation language such as PowerShell, Python, or Bash.
* Understanding of cloud cost management and FinOps principles, including tagging, cost ownership, budgeting, rightsizing, and optimization.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across global, cross-functional engineering teams.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with Azure Well-Architected Framework, Azure Landing Zone design principles, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), SLOs, or resilience testing.
* Experience supporting cloud foundations for data, analytics, or AI workloads, including secure connectivity, compute, storage, identity, and deployment automation.
* Exposure to multi-cloud engineering patterns or AWS/GCP is beneficial; Azure remains the primary focus of this role.
* Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400), or HashiCorp Terraform Associate are preferred, but equivalent practical experience is valued.
* Experience creating reusable platform services, self-service or 'golden path' capabilities, internal developer platforms, or cloud service catalogs.

**What Can We Give You?**

At The Toro Company, we are always working to make sure our employees know just how valued they are. In addition to a competitive salary, an affordable and top tier medical insurance plan many other great benefits - The Toro company offers employees , a variety of perks, including:

***Dress for your day*** - We know you're more productive when you're comfortable, which is why TTC employees are encouraged to take advantage of our casual, corporate environment.

***Location*** – Conveniently located **Baner, Pune** we are centrally located for most commuters!

***Food*** - Take advantage of our café, which serves both breakfast and lunch. You can grab a snack and a coffee at any time during your day.

***Wellness*** - The Toro Company offers complimentary use of our onsite fitness facility to employees. In addition to physical wellbeing, TTC offers a variety of mental health and financial health resources to all employees.

***Volunteerism*** - The Toro Company is proud to provide employees 20 hours of paid time to volunteer in the community.

***Flexible Work Arrangements*** – This team is currently implementing a hybrid work schedule. The opportunity to collaborate in the office and work from home part-time, has promoted team-building and flexibility.

NiCE is building SPARK, a new internal incubation team that turns great ideas from across CX International into working AI solutions, and then into enterprise-grade tools that roll out to colleagues around the world. **How will you make an impact?**
--------------------------------

You will own adoption for every SPARK solution, from the first conversation with the business through to sustained use at scale and be the voice of SPARK across the organization.

### **Plan and Lead Change**

  

* Assess change impact and readiness for each solution, and map stakeholders, concerns, and the behaviours that need to shift
* Serve as the primary **on-the-ground team leader** for SPARK initiatives, providing hands-on support throughout rollout and adoption phases.

* Work with the Project Manager so change milestones sit inside the delivery plan, not after it
* Address resistance and concerns openly, including questions about roles and job security, with honest and consistent messages

* Design and deliver role-based training, workshops, office hours, and self-paced content that teach people to use SPARK solutions in their own workflow

* Promote responsible and secure use of AI, in line with company guidance
* Be in constant engagement with key stakeholders and users to identify engagement roadmap

* Tell the SPARK story through demos, showcases, town halls, and internal roadshows that show what is possible and what is already working
* Build and run a network of AI champions across business units who help their peers adopt new tools and share what works
* Collect ideas from across the organisation and encourage colleagues to bring them to SPARK
* Act as a trusted adviser to senior leaders on how to lead their teams through AI-enabled change
* Draft and send communications as required for CX International, ELT as project sponsor working with NiCE Comms team and HR.

### **Measure and Improve Adoption**

* Define adoption and value measures: active use, depth of use, sentiment, behavior change, and benefits realized
* Run feedback loops with users, the Support Helpdesk, and the architects, turning recurring issues and requests into improvements
* Report adoption progress and lessons learned to sponsors, CX International Senior Leadership and steering committees

**Have you got what it takes?**
-------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in business, Organisational Development, Communications, Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* 12-18 years of experience in change management, transformation, or enablement, including a background in management or technology consulting
* Proven record of leading change for technology rollouts and shifts in ways of working, across multiple regions or business units
* Strong knowledge of structured change approaches such as Prosci ADKAR, Kotter certification, or equivalent
* Excellent storytelling, facilitation, and presentation skills, including with senior executives
* Experience designing and delivering training and enablement programs for non-technical audiences
* Hands-on fluency with generative AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Copilot, and a practical sense of what they can and cannot do
* Experience in using Notebook LLM, Synthesia, Beautiful.ai or equivalent.
* Ability to influence across teams without direct authority, and to use data to show progress
* Fluency in English

### **You will have an advantage if you also have:**

* Experience in software, SaaS, or technology companies or working for consulting company
* Agentic AI adoption project outside of India is a plus
* Experience running AI or digital champion networks
* Prosci ADKAR or an equivalent change management certification
* Instructional design or learning and development experience
* Experience speaking at internal or external events
* Experience working with teams across APAC, EMEA, and the Americas

**What's in it for you?**
-------------------------

SPARK is a chance to be a founding member of a brand-new team, and to shape how NiCE turns AI ideas into everyday tools used by colleagues around the world.

Join an ever-growing, market-disrupting, global company where the teams, comprised of the best of the best, work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! title: NOC & Office Manager
description:
**Job Purpose** :The NOC Manager leads, governs, and optimizes our 24/7/365 Global Network Operations Center based out of Pune. This role is responsible for driving operational excellence, maintaining high network availability, meeting strict SLA/KPI metrics, and leading a high-performing team of Shift Leads and L1/L2/L3 engineers. The IT & NOC Manager acts as the single point of accountability for major incident management, operational governance, vendor performance, and continuous process improvement across global and domestic network infrastructure.

**Key Responsibilities & Governance:**

**Operational Leadership & Team Management**

 Direct day-to-day operations of a multi-tiered 24/7/365 NOC team (L1, L2, L3 engineers,

and Shift Leads).

 Manage shift rostering, capacity planning, resource allocation, and holiday scheduling to

ensure 100% operational coverage without gap risks.

 Set team targets, drive performance evaluations (KPIs/OKRs), conduct regular 1-on-1s,

and build structured career progression pathways for team members.

 Lead hiring, onboarding, skill-gap assessments, and technical training programs to

continuously upgrade team capabilities.

**Service Level Management & SLA Governance:**

 Own service delivery metrics, including **MTTD** (Mean Time to Detect), **MTTR** (Mean

Time to Restore/Resolve), **First Contact Resolution (FCR), and SLA compliance**

**percentages.**

 Establish, audit, and refine Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), incident runbooks,

escalation matrixes, and shift handover protocols.

 Conduct regular ticket audit reviews to ensure operational quality, proper work notes

logging, and strict adherence to ITIL frameworks.

**Major Incident & Crisis Management:**

* Function as the ultimate operational escalation point for critical (P1/P2) network

outages and severe service degradations.

* Direct Major Incident Response bridges, ensuring coordinated technical response

between internal infrastructure teams, L3 architects, third-party vendors, and executive

leadership.

* Own the Problem Management process: oversee Root Cause Analysis (RCA)

investigations, draft executive Post-Incident Reports (PIR), and track corrective/preventive actions (CAPA) through completion.

**Vendor, Telecom & Executive Stakeholder Alignment**

 Manage performance and SLAs of major Indian and global telecommunications

providers and hardware OEMs.

 Drive quarterly business reviews (QBRs) with key suppliers to ensure circuit availability

and hardware RMA SLA compliance.

 Draft and deliver regular operational dashboards, trend analysis reports, and

performance summaries to executive leadership and global client stakeholders.

**Operational Automation & Process Improvement:**

 Identify opportunities to reduce operational noise through alert optimization,

automated event correlation, and self-healing workflow implementations.

 Partner with Cloud, Security (SOC), and Systems engineering teams to transition new

network technologies, branches, and cloud assets into active NOC monitoring.

**Required Qualifications & Experience:**

 **Education:** B.E. / B.Tech, MCA, or equivalent technical degree.

 **Experience:** 9 to 10 years in IT Infrastructure/Networking, with at least 4 to 6 years in a

formal NOC managerial or leadership role managing 24/7 operations teams.

**Certifications ( Highly Preferred ):**

**ITIL v4 Foundation / Managing Professional**

Technical credentials: **CCNP / CCIE** (Enterprise/Security), or equivalent vendor

certifications (Palo Alto PCNSE, Fortinet NSE 7).

Leadership / Project Management certs are strong advantages.

**Technical & Management Competencies:**

**Technical Depth:** Solid foundational understanding of enterprise networking (BGP, OSPF,

MPLS, SD-WAN, IPsec/SSL VPNs, VLANs, Firewalls) and cloud connectivity (AWS Direct

Connect, Azure ExpressRoute).

**ITSM & Monitoring Ecosystems:** Expertise in deploying and managing enterprise ITSM

platforms (ServiceNow, BMC Remedy, Jira Service Management) and monitoring suites

(SolarWinds, PRTG, Datadog, Splunk, Zabbix).

**Operational Governance:** Strong mastery of ITIL Incident, Problem, Change, and

Capacity Management processes.

**Analytics & Reporting:** Proficiency in data analysis, dashboard creation (Power BI,

Tableau, or ServiceNow Analytics), and trend forecasting.

**Soft Skills & Leadership Qualities:**

**Crisis Leadership:** Proven capability to remain composed, authoritative, and decisive

during complex high-severity incidents.

**Executive Communication:** Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills

to present technical concepts clearly to non-technical business leaders and enterprise

clients.

**People & Stakeholder Management:** Strong emotional intelligence, conflict resolution

capability, and team-building mindset.

Pay: ₹80,000.00 - ₹85,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Define, Design and Deliver (D3) is our in-house delivery philosophy. It’s culled from agile and rapid methodologies and focused on ‘just enough design’. We embrace this philosophy in everything we do, leading to numerous client success stories and indeed to our own success.

We embrace change, empowering and trusting our people and building long and valuable relationships with our employees, our customers and our partners. We work flexibly, even adopting traditional/waterfall methods where circumstances demand it. At Hoonartek, the focus is always on delivery and value.

**Job Description**

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Design and own the end-to-end data governance framework for the Databricks Data Foundation platform, covering data classification, ownership, stewardship, and quality standards.
* Architect Unity Catalog for metastore structure, catalog/schema hierarchy, fine-grained access controls (RBAC/ABAC), row- and column-level security, and audit logging across the migrated estate.
* Integrate Unity Catalog with enterprise data catalog and governance tooling (e.g. Collibra, Purview, or Alation) to give Allianz a single, consistent view of data lineage, glossary, and metadata across Databricks and connected systems.
* Define and implement data lineage capture (source-to-target) to support impact analysis, audit, and regulatory reporting during and after the Synapse-to-Databricks migration.
* Partner with data engineering, security, and platform teams to embed governance controls into migration pipelines for both Phase 1 (in progress) and the upcoming Phase 2 source systems.
* Ensure the governance model satisfies insurance-sector regulatory requirements (e.g. GDPR, BCBS 239, Solvency II) and Allianz's internal data policies.
* Act as the governance subject-matter expert in Allianz Technology engagement forums, including SteerCo and status reporting, translating technical governance decisions for business and compliance stakeholders.
* Mentor engineers on governance best practices and review designs for compliance before deployment.

**Required Skills & Experience**
--------------------------------

* 10+ years in data architecture/engineering, with at least 3-4 years focused on data governance in cloud data platforms.
* Hands-on expertise architecting and administering **Databricks Unity Catalog**: metastores, catalogs, access control, lineage, audit logs, and Delta Sharing.
* Proven experience integrating Databricks with enterprise data catalog/governance tools such as **Collibra, Microsoft Purview, or Alation**.
* Worked on Azure as hyperscaler in past project
* Has worked on Informatica earlier and understands Data Governance implementation
* Strong grounding in data governance frameworks and concepts: data stewardship, master data management, data quality, metadata management, and data lineage.
* Experience with large-scale cloud data platform migrations (Synapse, Azure Data Factory, or equivalent, to Databricks/Lakehouse architectures preferred).
* Working knowledge of regulatory and compliance frameworks relevant to insurance/BFSI (GDPR, BCBS 239, Solvency II, or similar).
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience presenting to senior client and SteerCo audiences.
* Prior experience working within a large enterprise client engagement model (consulting/systems integrator background preferred).

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Databricks certification (e.g. Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional, or Databricks Lakehouse/Unity Catalog specialty credentials).
* Certification or hands-on experience with Collibra, Purview, or Alation administration.
* Prior experience in insurance or broader insurance services, especially on regulatory/audit-driven data programmes.
* Familiarity with Azure cloud services beyond Synapse (Azure Data Lake, Azure Key Vault, Azure Purview).
* Experience defining governance operating models (data ownership RACI, stewardship councils, policy lifecycle).

title: Senior Identity Access Management Administrator
description:
**About Advanced Energy**

  

Advanced Energy (Nasdaq: AEIS) is a global leader in the design and manufacturing of highly engineered, precision power conversion, measurement and control solutions for mission-critical applications and processes. AE’s power solutions enable customer innovation in complex applications for a wide range of industries including semiconductor equipment, industrial, manufacturing, telecommunications, data center computing and healthcare. Advanced Energy has devoted four decades to perfecting power for its global customers and is headquartered in Denver, Colorado.

  

**Why be a part of advanced energy?**

  

Some people say it’s like working in the best of two worlds. We operate like an agile, growing, small company – you can see your work make a difference to the company every day. Things move quickly and you can see and feel it. At the same time, we’re a global company founded in 1981 and have been publicly traded for more than 28 years. We have a strong cash position, deep trust and partnership with leading customers, a global best-in-class operations capability, and a proven leadership team. We have a track record and resources to make things happen both organically and inorganically. Being part of a nimble company with a solid foundation attracts team members that are capable, driven and like a challenge. Our employees collaborate and know how to have fun inventing, working, building and winning together. At our core, we are Advanced Energy – powering the future, together.

  

**Position Summary****:**

  

The Senior IT Security Administrator plays a critical role in shaping the future of identity security at Advanced Energy. This position offers the opportunity to lead enterprise-wide IAM initiatives, influence Zero Trust and AI Security strategy, and modernize identity controls across global cloud and SaaS environments. Working alongside security, infrastructure, and business leaders, you will drive solutions that protect the business while enabling growth and innovation. This is an opportunity to make a visible impact in a global technology organization.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* **IAM Administration**

* Design, implement, and maintain enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions supporting workforce, application, and AI/Non-human identities.
* Lead the integration, administration, and optimization of IAM platforms.
* Establish scalable identity solutions that support cloud-first and hybrid environments.
* Evaluate emerging IAM technologies and industry best practices to strengthen the organization's security posture.
  

* **Identity Governance & Access Management**

* Lead initiatives related to Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), Access Management, AI Security, Identity Threat Detection and Response (ITDR), and Zero Trust security programs.
* Design and implement identity lifecycle management processes, including provisioning, deprovisioning, role management, and access certification activities.
* Develop and maintain authorization models including Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC), and Policy-Based Access Control (PBAC).
* Support segregation of duties (SoD), least privilege, just-in-time access, and privileged account governance programs.
  

* **Authentication & Directory Services**

* Administer and enhance enterprise Zero Trust controls, including Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), passwordless authentication, federation, conditional access controls, and network micro segmentation.
* Manage and support on-premise, cloud, and hybrid identity environments.
* Configure Identity Protection policies, Conditional Access policies, risk-based authentication controls, and adaptive access capabilities.
* Design and maintain integrations between identity platforms, cloud services, and business applications through APIs, provisioning connectors, and automation frameworks.
  

* **Cloud & Application Integration**

* Implement secure identity integrations with enterprise applications, SaaS platforms, and cloud environments including Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud Platform.
* Partner with application owners and development teams to ensure secure authentication and authorization controls are implemented consistently across platforms.
* Support application onboarding, federation, provisioning, and access governance activities.
  

* **Automation & Operational Excellence**

* Develop automation solutions using PowerShell, Python, SQL, Power Automate, or similar technologies to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, operational procedures, and support runbooks.
* Recommend and implement process improvements that enhance security, user experience, and operational effectiveness.
  

* **Leadership & Collaboration**

* Serve as a senior IAM subject matter expert and trusted advisor to Information Security, IT, Audit, Compliance, and business stakeholders.
* Lead technical projects from planning and design through deployment and operational transition.
* Mentor junior employees and provide technical guidance across IAM-related initiatives.
* Support audit, compliance, and regulatory activities by implementing appropriate controls and providing required evidence.
  

* **Additional Duties**

* Participate in identity-related incident response activities and root cause investigations.
* Stay informed of emerging IAM threats, technologies, and industry trends.
* Perform other duties as assigned.
  

**Working Conditions**

  

* Location: Pune, India
* Environment: Standard office environment utilizing standard office equipment; some travel may be necessary.
* Ability to work on projects with global team members outside of standard office hours.
* Weekend work and overtime may be required.
* Works in team and individual environments.
* Up to 25% travel (more may be necessary for projects); domestic and international.
  

**Qualifications:**

  

**Required Qualifications**

  

* Advanced knowledge of Identity and Access Management (IAM) principles, Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), Zero Trust, AI Security, Identity Directory Services, Authentication and Authorization, and the Identity Lifecycle Management.
* Strong understanding of modern identity security concepts, including Zero Trust, least privilege, adaptive authentication, attribute and risk-based access controls, continuous access evaluation, and identity threat detection and response (ITDR).
* Advanced knowledge of on-premise, cloud, and hybrid identity environments.
* Knowledge of access control frameworks, including Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC), and Policy-Based Access Control (PBAC).
* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong organizational and project leadership skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and initiatives simultaneously.
* Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.
* Ability to develop and maintain technical documentation, standards, procedures, and operational runbooks.
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of regulatory and compliance frameworks such as SOX, NIST, ISO 27001, and CIS Controls.
* Familiarity with IT and Security platforms or applications within Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Zero Trust, AI Security and other enterprise driven product families.
* Understanding of cloud security architectures within Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud Platform environments.
  

**Experience**

  

**Required Experience**

* Five (5) or more years of experience in Identity and Access Management, Cybersecurity Engineering, Information Security, or a related technical discipline.
* Three (3) or more years of experience administering and supporting enterprise IAM platforms and access management processes.
* Three (3) or more years of experience supporting on-premise, cloud, and/or hybrid identity directory services in a medium-to-large enterprise environment.
* Experience implementing and supporting Enterprise Identity, Zero Trust, and AI Security solutions.
* Experience administering and maturing enterprise Zero Trust solutions, including Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), federation services, and conditional access policies.
* Experience integrating identity platforms with cloud providers, enterprise applications, and SaaS solutions.
* Experience designing and implementing user provisioning, deprovisioning, access reviews, role management, and access certification processes.
* Experience developing automation solutions using PowerShell, Python, SQL, Power Automate, or similar technologies.
* Experience leading technical projects from planning and design through implementation and operational support.
* Experience collaborating with Information Security, Infrastructure, Application Development, Audit, and business stakeholders to deliver IAM solutions.
  

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience with IAM platforms and technologies.
* Experience supporting global or manufacturing organizations.
* Experience supporting regulatory audits, compliance initiatives, and remediation activities.
* Experience implementing Zero Trust, Privileged Access Management, AI Security, or enterprise IAM modernization programs.

**Role Summary**

**The L2 Cloud Operations Support Engineer** will provide operational support for Abbott’s Azure and AWS cloud-hosted environment, covering IaaS, cloud-native networking, Kubernetes platforms, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipelines, backup and restoration, and high availability and disaster recovery. The role requires hands-on troubleshooting, automation, disciplined change execution, and effective coordination with Abbott, cloud providers, security teams, and internal CloudOps stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**1. Cloud-hosted IaaS Environment Support**
--------------------------------------------

* Provide L2 operational support for cloud-hosted IaaS environments and resolve incidents, service requests, and technical issues within agreed processes.
* Coordinate with Azure and AWS support teams for cloud service-related issue resolution, escalation management, and service continuity.
* Leverage, maintain, and enhance automation scripts to streamline recurring operational and support activities.
* Provision virtual machines using approved operating system golden images through Terraform and Ansible.
* Identify unused or idle virtual machines and coordinate their power-down to optimise cloud consumption and cost.
* Decommission cloud resources in accordance with Abbott’s approved cloud decommissioning process.
* Provide technical coordination for mutually agreed maintenance activities between Abbott and the CloudOps team.

**2. Cloud-native Networking Services**
---------------------------------------

* Provision and update VPCs, VNETs, subnets, route configurations, and associated cloud networking components based on approved designs and change requests.
* Provision cloud infrastructure resources using Terraform for third-party firewall platforms, including Zscaler and Alkira, in accordance with designs and requirements provided by Abbott’s Security Team.
* Troubleshoot L2 connectivity and configuration issues and coordinate with network, security, application, and cloud provider teams for resolution.

**3. Kubernetes Platform Operations**
-------------------------------------

* Provide operational support for cloud-native Kubernetes platforms, including container provisioning, application deployment support, and container lifecycle management.
* Monitor Kubernetes cluster health, capacity, availability, and operational events across all in-scope clusters.
* Capture and report agreed Kubernetes metrics and KPIs and escalate recurring, critical, or capacity-related issues to the appropriate support teams.
* Perform approved standard operational changes and troubleshooting using documented procedures and runbooks.

**4. Infrastructure Orchestration, Automation and CI/CD**
---------------------------------------------------------

* Leverage and enhance Abbott’s existing orchestration, automation, and CI/CD processes for cloud infrastructure management.
* Execute cloud infrastructure pipeline deployments and configuration activities using Terraform and Ansible for in-scope IaaS, CaaS, and PaaS services.
* Orchestrate cloud infrastructure services and resource provisioning within Abbott’s existing cloud Landing Zones.
* Monitor infrastructure pipelines during deployment, analyse failures, perform initial troubleshooting, and coordinate resolution or escalation.
* Maintain reusable Infrastructure as Code modules, scripts, configuration artefacts, and operational documentation under approved version-control and change-management practices.

**5. Backup and Restoration**
-----------------------------

* Coordinate backup and restoration activities for Storage Accounts and virtual machines using approved cloud-native backup solutions.
* Perform backup administration, job monitoring, failure handling, restoration support, and backup reporting for in-scope services.
* Validate backup status and restoration outcomes, document evidence, and escalate exceptions or repeated failures through the agreed support process.

**6. High Availability and Disaster Recovery Support**
------------------------------------------------------

* Coordinate and execute periodic disaster recovery infrastructure failover and failback tests using the existing approved DR test plan.
* Configure and support Azure Site Recovery for virtual machine-based failover across Azure regions based on approved design inputs.
* Perform failover and failback testing to identify infrastructure gaps in the DR design and plan, and document findings for review.
* Facilitate infrastructure prerequisites before DR testing as requested by the DR Design and Build team.
* Support issue resolution, evidence collection, status reporting, and post-test remediation tracking for DR exercises.

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Google SecOps Engineer to lead and deliver Google Security Operations (SecOps) implementation, migration, detection engineering, parser development, and SOAR automation initiatives. The ideal candidate must have hands-on experience with Google SecOps SIEM and SOAR capabilities, successful execution of end-to-end migration projects, and expertise in YARA-L detection engineering. * Minimum 1+ year of hands-on experience with Google SecOps implementations and operations.
* Proven experience delivering at least one full-cycle Google SecOps migration project.
* Strong expertise in Google SecOps SIEM and SOAR capabilities.

* Strong understanding of threat detection, threat hunting, SOC operations, and incident response processes.
* Experience integrating EDR, IAM, Cloud Security, Vulnerability Management, Email Security, and Security Operations platforms.

**Job Description:**

**Cloud Infrastructure Engineer**

*Platform architecture and evolution*

**Function -** Infrastructure & Operations

**Coverage -** Across all clients

**Role Overview**
-----------------

The Cloud Infrastructure Engineer is the senior technical owner of Merkle Denmark’s cloud platform architecture. The role focuses on designing, building, and evolving the cloud foundations, guardrails, and platform capabilities that underpin client operations — ensuring environments are reliable, secure, and well-governed.

The role is a hands-on specialist position. It sets the direction for how cloud infrastructure is designed, built, and hardened across client accounts, and provides deep technical input on complex incidents, major changes, and architecture-impacting decisions. People leadership, resource allocation, and day-to-day team direction sit with the Engineering Director.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Cloud Infrastructure Engineering**

* Architect and build cloud foundations and platform capabilities across client environments.
* Define secure-by-design patterns, guardrails, and platform standards for Cloud Operations to operate within.
* Design resilience and continuity architecture, including backup/restore strategy and disaster recovery.
* Own and evolve infrastructure-as-code (IaC) practices and tooling standards.
* Drive continuous improvement of the platform approach, ensuring it evolves with client needs and industry practice.
* Provide specialist guidance to Cloud Operations Engineers during complex incident investigations, major changes, and architecture-impacting decisions.
* Assess and respond to critical CVEs and security advisory items, coordinating with dentsu EMEA security where required.

**Operational Governance**

* Define platform-level patterns that support incident management, change management, SLA governance, and on-call practice.
* Provide senior technical input on P1/critical incidents and client-impacting situations where infrastructure or platform expertise is needed.
* Ensure platform ownership responsibilities are clearly defined and applied — Cloud Ops owns production stability; Cloud Infrastructure owns design and evolution.
* Maintain platform design standards that support audit-readiness, NIS2, and client contractual obligations.
* Contribute to operational reporting quality, including platform health signals and SLA-relevant metrics.

**Client & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Act as senior technical point of contact for client escalations requiring infrastructure or platform expertise.
* Collaborate with Project Managers and delivery teams on change planning, release readiness, and deployment governance.
* Contribute to account-level technical conversations, including architecture reviews and SLA design.
* Support pre-sales and proposal work where infrastructure architecture or managed operations expertise is required.

**Must-Have Skillset –**
------------------------

  

**Cloud Infrastructure Engineer -Over 8+ years of exp**
-------------------------------------------------------

  

* **Cloud Architecture Expertise** (Azure, AWS, or GCP)Design scalable, secure, and resilient cloud platforms Define platform guardrails and architecture standards
* **Infrastructure as Code (IaC)**Strong hands-on experience with **Terraform, Bicep, ARM, or equivalent** Building and maintaining automated infrastructure deployments
* **Cloud Security & Compliance** Secure-by-design architecture principles Platform-level security controls, vulnerability/CVE management Understanding of compliance frameworks, governance, and audit requirements
* **Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity** Design and implementation of DR, backup, restore, and resilience strategiesHigh availability and fault-tolerant architecture design
* **ITIL / ITSM Knowledge** Strong understanding of: Incident Management hange Management Problem Management SLA Governance
* **Critical Incident & Escalation Management** Experience providing technical leadership during P1/P0 incidents Root cause analysis and architecture-level problem resolution
* **Operational Governance** Define platform standards, operational patterns, and best practices Support incident, change, and service management frameworks
* **Client & Stakeholder Management** Act as senior technical advisor during architecture reviews Experience working directly with enterprise clients and stakeholders
* **Multi-Cloud & Managed Services Experience** Experience in professional services, managed operations, or multi-client environments Understanding of contractual obligations, SLAs, and service delivery models
* **Technical Skills** Networking (VNet/VPC, VPN, Load Balancers, DNS, Firewalls)Windows/Linux Server Administration Containers & Kubernetes Monitoring & Observability tools Automation and Scripting (PowerShell, Bash, Python)
* Experience with NIS2, GDPR, and data processing regulations
* Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or CI/CD expertise
* Excellent written and verbal English communication Ability to translate technical concepts for business stakeholders

**Nice-to-Have**
----------------

* Danish language proficiency
* Public sector or enterprise platform experience

**Working Context**
-------------------

The role sits within the Merkle Denmark engineering organisation, reporting to the CTO and working closely with the Engineering Director, Infrastructure & Operations. The Infrastructure & Operations function is distributed across Denmark, Bulgaria, India, and the Philippines, and operates across multiple client accounts including public sector and enterprise digital platforms.

The function works within a ticket-first, evidence-driven operational model. Production is owned by Cloud Operations; platform architecture and guardrails are owned by Cloud Infrastructure Engineering. This separation of duties supports governance, auditability, and clear accountability.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

QloudX is looking for a technically strong and customer-focused **Operations Lead** to strengthen its AWS Managed Services (MSP) practice.

As our MSP business continues to grow, we are expanding our operational leadership capacity to support additional customer engagements, maintain service quality, and ensure scalable 24×7 operations.

The selected candidate will work alongside the existing Operations Lead, sharing responsibility for day-to-day operations, assigned customer accounts, team management, technical escalations, and continuous service improvement.

This is a **hands-on technical leadership role** requiring strong AWS infrastructure knowledge, operational discipline, customer-facing communication, and the ability to lead engineers in a fast-paced managed services environment.

The ideal candidate should be capable of independently managing MSP customer operations while actively contributing to the growth and maturity of the practice.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1. MSP Operations & Service Delivery**

* Take end-to-end operational ownership of assigned MSP customer accounts and service delivery activities.
* Collaborate with the existing Operations Lead to ensure seamless 24×7 operational coverage and clearly defined responsibilities.
* Manage daily operations, including incident, service request, problem, and change management in accordance with agreed SLAs.
* Oversee shift schedules, resource allocation, handovers, and on-call escalation arrangements.
* Ensure timely resolution of incidents and service requests while maintaining customer satisfaction.
* Monitor operational KPIs, including SLA compliance, MTTA, MTTR, ticket backlog, and recurring incidents.
* Lead major incident management, including technical coordination, customer communication, RCA, and preventive actions.
* Maintain operational documentation, SOPs, runbooks, and knowledge repositories.
* Drive operational efficiency through automation, process improvements, and proactive monitoring.

### **2. Customer & Service Management**

* Act as the primary operational point of contact for assigned MSP customers.
* Build strong customer relationships through proactive communication and consistent service delivery.
* Conduct regular operational reviews covering SLA performance, incidents, security findings, cost optimization, and improvement initiatives.
* Manage customer escalations independently, ensuring timely communication and resolution.
* Coordinate onboarding and transition of new customers into MSP operations, including access management, monitoring setup, documentation, and operational readiness.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer environments in terms of availability, performance, security, and cost.
* Collaborate with account management and practice leadership on service expansion opportunities.
* Ensure operational activities remain aligned with agreed SOWs, service boundaries, and customer commitments.

### **3. Technical Leadership & Escalation Management**

* Provide hands-on technical guidance to L1/L2 engineers for troubleshooting and incident resolution.
* Act as a technical escalation point for complex AWS infrastructure and operational issues.
* Troubleshoot issues across AWS compute, storage, networking, databases, security, and monitoring services.
* Coordinate complex technical escalations with L3 engineers, AWS Support, and third-party vendors.
* Review technical solutions, operational changes, and remediation plans to ensure reliability and security.
* Support AWS infrastructure optimization, including availability, performance, security, backup, and disaster recovery.
* Identify recurring technical issues and implement permanent fixes, automation, or preventive controls.
* Ensure production changes follow established change management and approval processes.

### **4. Team Leadership & Capability Development**

* Lead, mentor, and support cloud operations engineers across L1, L2, and L3 functions.
* Ensure adequate technical guidance and leadership availability across operational shifts.
* Conduct regular team reviews, knowledge-sharing sessions, and technical training.
* Review ticket quality, troubleshooting approaches, documentation, and customer communication.
* Identify skill gaps and develop training and AWS certification plans.
* Support hiring, technical interviews, onboarding, and performance evaluations.
* Promote accountability, collaboration, operational discipline, and continuous improvement within the team.
* Develop team capabilities to reduce dependency on senior engineers for routine operational activities.

### **5. MSP Practice Growth & Operational Scalability**

* Support the MSP Practice Head in scaling operations as new customer accounts are onboarded.
* Contribute to resource capacity planning, shift coverage models, and operational workload distribution.
* Help standardize processes, monitoring frameworks, runbooks, and service delivery practices across customer accounts.
* Identify automation opportunities to improve operational efficiency and reduce repetitive manual activities.
* Support operational readiness assessments for new customer engagements.
* Contribute to service quality improvements, operational reporting, and governance initiatives.
* Support AWS MSP program requirements, operational best practices, and compliance readiness.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* **5–8 years of experience** in IT infrastructure, cloud operations, or managed services, including at least 4 years of hands-on AWS experience.

* **Compute:** EC2, Auto Scaling, Lambda
* **Networking:** VPC, Route 53, ELB, VPN, Security Groups, NACLs
* **Storage & Databases:** S3, EBS, RDS
* **Security & Identity:** IAM, CloudTrail, AWS Config
* **Monitoring & Operations:** CloudWatch, AWS Systems Manager, AWS Backup

* Ability to coordinate major incidents and communicate effectively with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Strong problem-solving, decision-making, and prioritization skills.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication.
* Ability to manage multiple customer environments and competing operational priorities.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* ITIL Foundation certification.
* Experience working in an AWS Managed Services Provider environment.

**Overview**
------------

### **About us**

We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.

As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.

**About GSS**

  
As the internal support organization for DNV and DNV owned companies, we deliver shared services within Human Resources, Finance, IT and Real Estate & Procurement to DNV globally. Our mission is to enable DNV to grow, succeed with its business goals and improve competitiveness. Customer experience is at the core of everything we do. GSS is responsible for many of the tools, processes and daily routines that create the backbone of DNV.

### **About the role**

The Finance Applications team is part of the Core Applications unit within DNV’s Global Shared Services IT. The team focuses on establishing, maintaining, and supporting a full overview of finance applications to ensure stable end-to-end operations across the globe. With Oracle eBusiness Suite at its core, additional products to complement the key processes such as purchasing, banking, credit collection, and invoicing, are also part of the finance suite. A well-functioning and up-to-date finance system acts as a key engine to support our organization’s commercial and financial commitments, with integrations to our business production and reporting tools.

**Role Description and Responsibilities:**

The Intercompany and Tax Functional Expert is part of Intercompany and Tax team within Finance Applications unit. As with all Finance Applications (FA) teams, the employees are located across the globe, with most of the team members based in the Global Shared Service Centers in Pune (India) and Gdynia (Poland). The team works as one unit regardless of location, and work is prioritized based on customer needs and skills, not location. The Intercompany & Tax team supports Project Intercompany, AGIS, Oracle E-Business Tax (eBTax), and LATAM tax solutions, including Latin Tax Engine and Integrated Receiving. Oracle E-Business Suite is the primary application supported, with close collaboration across Basware Cloud, integrated production systems, and other FA streams.

Key responsibilities:

* Maintain Finance Applications solutions in line with the global template while supporting relevant country-specific requirements.
* Collaborate with the Intercompany & Tax team and other Finance Applications teams to resolve customer and production issues quickly and to a high standard.
* Assess tax regulation changes and business requirements and translate them into appropriate tax solutions.
* Align proposed solutions with Solution Architects and Global Process Experts before development and implementation.
* Manage the functional delivery lifecycle, including solution design, configuration, documentation, testing, implementation, and production support.
* Maintain high-quality functional documentation in accordance with agreed standards and best practices.
* Engage with customers and stakeholders at all organizational levels to explain supported solutions, clarify requirements, and provide progress updates.

### **What we offer**

* Flexible work arrangements for better work-life balance.
* Generous Paid Leaves (Annual, Sick, Compassionate, Local Public, Marriage, Maternity, Paternity, Medical leave).
* Medical benefits (Insurance and Annual Health Check-up).
* Pension and Insurance Policies (Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance, Travel Insurance).
* Training and Development Assistance (Training Sponsorship, On-The-Job Training, Training Programme).
* Additional Benefits (Long Service Awards, Mobile Phone Reimbursement).
* Company bonus/Profit share.

\*Benefits may vary based on position, tenure/contract/grade level\*

DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.

### **About you**

* Senior level with at least 4 years of experience in Oracle Financials and Oracle E-Business Tax (eBTax)
* Hands-on experience with tax localizations, preferably:
  + India
  + US/Canada
  + Brazil
* Experience with tax determination across Oracle E-Business Suite transactions originating from Service Contracts, Service Requests, Projects, Project Intercompany, Receivables, and Payables.
* Strong understanding of Oracle E-Business Tax configuration and tax determination rules.
* Experience with troubleshooting tax calculation and transaction issues in Oracle E-Business Suite.
* Experience with translating tax regulation changes and new business requirements into solution design, configuration, testing, implementation, and production support.
* Proven ability to meet timelines and deliver high-quality results.
* Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
* Proactive and self-driven, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to identify issues, drive improvements, and work independently.
* Well-organized, detail-oriented, and capable of producing high-quality documentation, analyses, presentations, and user guidance.
* Fluent in written and spoken English.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a global, cross-functional environment.
* Strong Microsoft Office skills, including Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.

*Security and compliance with statutory requirements in the countries in which we operate is essential for DNV. Background checks will be conducted on all final candidates as part of the offer process, in accordance with applicable country-specific laws and practices.*

**Benefits**
------------

Please note that some benefits may vary depending on location, business area, and employment terms. Please confirm with your recruiter.

### **Profit Share**

You’ll be part of our global profit share scheme that means we all share in our success as a business. If we profit, so do you. This will be part of our Total Compensation approach each year and depends on our year-end results.

### **Insurance**

Taking care of you with travel, life, and accident insurance.

### **Pension Schemes**

We care about your long-term financial security and prioritize pension and retirement benefits to reflect our caring values.

### **Professional Development**

We believe in the 70/20/10 learning model, where 70% of your learning comes from performing your everyday tasks and working on different projects, new areas and initiatives to gain new skills. 20% from working with others and mentoring and the rest from formal education.

### **Hybrid Working**

Adapting to the changing world of work around the world.

### **Purpose-led organization**

You become part of a world-leading company where we know and live our purpose; to safeguard life, property, and the environment, with the opportunity to tackle global change through your work.

observability | ~10% collaboration & documentation

**Key Responsibilities**
  
**Service Catalog & Platform Governance**

* Build and maintain a minimalistic, opinionated service catalog of approved cloud components across Google Cloud and Azure
* Apply a serverless-first, PaaS-first philosophy — challenge complexity and push back on
    
  unnecessary infrastructure sprawl
* For every approved catalog entry, deliver production-ready configuration: IaC, security baseline,observability hooks, and runbook
* Scrutinise every new component request and justify its addition in terms of cost, operational overhead, and platform alignment

**Cloud Architecture**

* Define, document, and govern cloud architectural blueprints across networking, compute, storage and data layers
* Design event-driven pipelines that trigger AI-assisted validation, drift detection, and deployment gates
* Serve as the technical authority on platform design decisions within your domain

**LLM-Driven Operations**

* Implement LLM-based automated deployment capabilities using tools such as OpenCode, Claude Code, or equivalent frameworks
* Design and operate infrastructure workflows augmented by AI agents — from deployment validation to configuration drift detection
* Stay ahead of the market in AI-assisted tooling and bring relevant innovations into the platform

**Observability**

* Define the observability standard: structured logging, distributed tracing, alerting, dashboards, and SLO/SLA frameworks
* Establish platform-level KPIs and ensure consistent adoption across engineering teams

**Collaboration**

* Partner with DevOps and Engineering teams to embed platform standards into delivery pipelines
* Partner with SecOps to integrate all controls and security requirements
* Document everything: blueprints, ADRs, runbooks, onboarding guides

**What you need to fulfill the role**
-------------------------------------

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
  
You have operated multi-cloud Kubernetes environments in production, built IaC pipelines with Terraform and have hands-on experience with LLM-driven tooling in real engineering workflows. Specifically:

* Proven cloud networking experience: firewalls, gateways, VPCs, VPNs, private service connect, and network security groups
* Strong, current proficiency across **Google Cloud Platform** (GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, VPC, Cloud Armor, Pub/Sub, Artifact Registry) and **Microsoft Azure**
* Proven IaC experience with **Terraform** (required); Ansible a strong plus
* **Proven hands-on LLM tooling experience**: must have used **OpenCode, Claude Code,** or equivalent AI-assisted coding/deployment agents in real engineering workflows
* **Kubernetes at scale:** demonstrated experience operating **AKS** (Azure Kubernetes Service) and **GKE** (Google Kubernetes Engine) — cluster lifecycle, upgrades, networking, and workload management
* Experience with **Vertex AI, Azure AI Foundry, or similar cloud** model gardens
* Ability to proactively coordinate with stakeholders to remove ambiguity and build clarity in migration designs
* Experience in Agile/fast-iteration environments with high individual ownership

**Nice-to-Have (Bonus Skills)**

* Knowledge of C5, SecNumCloud, ISO 27001, or equivalent cloud security frameworks
* FinOps — cost attribution, rightsizing, commitment strategies
* Prior experience in a SaaS product company at scale
* Platform engineering / SRE background

**Soft Skills**

* Intense technical curiosity — you follow the market, test new tools, and form opinions before they become mainstream
* Strong problem-solving discipline: you reach for first principles, not familiarity
* Ownership mindset — you build it, you run it, you improve it
* Clear written and verbal communication: able to document decisions and explain them to non specialists
* Operates well under pressure and tight constraints — energised by hard problems
* Strong negotiation skills — fact-driven and data-driven: you argue with evidence, not opinion
* Highly collaborative: you build alignment across engineering, SecOps, and leadership

**What success looks like**

We target a mature and highly automated cloud foundation designed for modern enterprise SaaS. The long-term success of this role is defined by:

* **Robust Service Catalog & Governance:** An established service catalog baseline featuring approved, standardized cloud components with built-in compliance, IaC automation, and production-ready monitoring.
* **Enterprise-Wide Observability Adoption:** Broad deployment of unified platform-level observability standards across engineering teams, incorporating logging, distributed tracing, and clear SLA frameworks.

* **Sustainable Architecture Blueprints:** Completed architectural blueprints and ADR documents defining the multi-cloud framework, paired with scalable FinOps cost tracking principles.

**You're probably NOT a fit if**

* You need a large team to delegate to before making decisions
* You prefer deep specialisation in a single cloud over breadth across two
* You're not actively following the LLM/AI tooling space
* You're looking for a role with clearly defined scope and minimal ambiguity

title: Enterprise Architect
description:
**Hello Visionary!**

We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly evolving world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make an outstanding addition to our vibrant team. Siemens Mobility is an independent handled company of Siemens AG. Its core business includes rail vehicles, rail automation and electrification solutions, turnkey systems, intelligent road traffic technology and related services. The Information Technology (IT) department has the global responsibility for the internal IT of Siemens Mobility. Its goal is to provide a robust and efficient IT landscape derived from business and market demands. Your personality and individuality make the difference. In our team, we increase business performance and point the way into the digital age. Is that exactly your thing? Then live your passion in a cross-location team in which you can actively craft the future of our company. You open up new possibilities for our customers with your competence. Connected with this is an exciting career path that leads you to ever new projects and solutions in the field of IT for Siemens Mobility.

**We are looking for an Enterprise Architect**

**You’ll make a difference by:**

As member of our global Enterprise Architecture team at SMO IT you play an important role in digital transition and establishing the enterprise function in our company as enabling partner for our business to achieve business goals and position IT as enabler.

* As part of a global team, you will be responsible for enterprise architecture management (including business IT alignment and analysis of the application portfolio) and derive IT strategies from business requirements.
* Lead IT transformation programs passionate about optimizing the application portfolio to support business objectives and improve operational efficiency.
* Ensure interoperability of different applications within the enterprise according to modern integration pattern and domain driven design.
* Provide architectural guidance and governance for new solutions, services and ensure their compliance with the existing architectural landscape.
* Define intentional architecture as a purposeful set of statements, models, and decisions that represent some future architectural state, and derive the roadmap to achieve this state.
* Shape the target operation model on cloud infrastructures together with the cloud competence center
* Apply and contribute to governance frameworks that ensure compliance, security, and alignment with enterprise architecture principles.
* Engage with key collaborators to establish IT as enabler and partner for value proposition, and ensure that enterprise architecture initiatives meet business needs.
* Shift from experience-based to fact-based decision-making by the means of the enterprise repository

**You’ll win us over by:**

* Bachelor/master’s degree or equivalent experience in computer science or comparable education with corresponding additional skills
* Proven experience in enterprise architecture, with a focus on IT transformation programs in enterprise context
* Proven skills in the field of Enterprise Architecture Management, relevant certifications (e.g., TOGAF, PMP) is a plus.
* Experience with LeanIX for EAM is a plus
* Sound knowledge from anyone or more aspect of Business Architecture, Application Architecture, Data Architecture, Technology Architecture.
* Experience in architecture design and modeling
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to actively engage and influence senior leadership and key collaborators.
* Experience in leading IT projects, including budget management and resource allocation with the ability to align IT initiatives with business objectives.
* Ability to lead multiple priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, and adapt to changing business needs.
* Understand the business & technical architecture concepts for sophisticated IT architectures.
* Knowledge in IT governance, risk management, and emerging technologies; familiarity with application portfolio management tools and techniques is a plus.
* Experiences in one of our technology domains: IoT, AI, Cloud native ideally in combination with domain expertise in logistics, manufacturing or other subject areas in railways industries

**Join us and be yourself!**

We value your outstanding identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and build a better tomorrow with us.

**Make your mark in our exciting world at Siemens.**

This role is based in Pune and is an Individual contributor role. You might be required to visit other locations within India and outside. In return, you'll get the chance to work with teams impacting - and the shape of things to come. We're Siemens. A collection of over 379,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and inspiration and help us shape tomorrow.

Find out more about Siemens careers at: www.siemens.com/careers & more about mobility at https://new.siemens.com/global/en/products/mobility.html
